create_multiplexstate: create a MultiplexState with bucket assignments, device, dtype, and allowed bucket capacity for tensor multiplexing
build_multiplexcontroller: build a MultiplexController module to manage multiplex state across training and evaluation modes
run_multiplexstate_mux: run the MultiplexState mux method to convert tensors from data space to multiplex space
run_multiplexstate_demux: run the MultiplexState demux method to convert tensors from multiplex space back to data space
add_multiplexstate_objects: add objects to MultiplexState by filling empty slots or creating new buckets as needed
remove_multiplexstate_objects: remove objects from MultiplexState by marking them as removed and cleaning up empty buckets
get_multiplexstate_valid_mask: get the valid object mask tensor from MultiplexState indicating which bucket slots are occupied
